'''Witenko Revised Starships Galore! Light Side''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Witenko]]
* '''Published:''' 18 December 2002 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS3]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Yavin 4: Massassi War Room|Premiere-L-yavin4massassiwarroom.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Yavin 4: Massassi War Room
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS3 Yavin 4 Massassi War Room Witenko.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

This is a revised deck of StarShips Galore. Please let me know what you think and if you have any comments or suggestions I'd be glad to hear them.

The published list has 61 cards.

== Strategy ==

What I really try to do is overpower my opponent in air.  Even though I may be force-drained on land, my main focus is to take out my opponents life force in space.  However, I do have a few cards for ground forces. As a starting interrupt, I play 'Heading for the Medical Frigate' to get me three effects right off the bat, usually being 'Squadron Assignments' and 'Launching the Assault' so now I have 'Home One' in my hand early on so I won't lose it during a force drain or battle. LIGHT SIDE DECK
